verdict.rationale: Mirrors documents a dry-run style preview of corrections against stored traces and a shadow mode that captures without delivering guidance. Neither is a separate, isolated sandbox environment for testing apart from production data: the preview replays stored production conversations, and shadow mode runs on live production traffic. These are adjacent dry-run controls, not the sandbox isolation the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
